replacement.title: Apply Electrical PE Stamp to Additional-Project Drawings
replacement.definition: Apply an Electrical PE stamp to the permit-ready electrical drawings for the separately discussed prospective project.

patches.decision_note: Electrical PE stamping is explicitly requested and can be performed or evaluated independently from creating the electrical drawings.

replacement.title: Use California Electrical PE Credentials for Additional Project
replacement.definition: Use an appropriately licensed California Electrical PE and provide the corresponding license information for the separately discussed permit project.

patches.decision_note: The California licensure requirement is jurisdiction-specific and independent from both Nevada credentials and physical application of the electrical stamp.
The client explicitly requires both review and stamping within two business days.
The two-business-day deadline explicitly applies to delivery of the stamp as well as the review.
The freelancer disputes the scope of additional stamps, not the requested drawing-callout presentation; the conflict is already represented under the stamping and comment-revision Requirements.
The documentation-format Requirement did not enter CLARIFY because the preceding dispute concerned additional stamping; its message-93 format change remains represented by MODIFY.
